name: Across the Peninsula
description:
Across the Peninsula
Old Portage Road, which ends near here, has been used to cross the peninsula since this shore was first settled. It closely parallels the Indian trail which was the way of the trapper and traveler in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
data_license: Michigan open data (Michigan DNR; attribution requested)
address: Roadside Park on US-2, just west of St. Ignace
